description:
1. Recursively enumerate and record the full paths of all regular files under /working into a file named "all_files.txt".
2. From "all_files.txt", select entries whose filename is exactly "workspace" and verify each is a regular file (not a directory or special file), then save the verified paths to "matches.txt".
3. Stage a one-line file named "result_pending.txt" that will contain yes if "matches.txt" contains at least one path, or no if it is empty, to be used by the final output step.

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).

create.init: rm -rf /working; mkdir /working && echo 123>/working/.tmp && echo 123>/working/.tm12p && echo 123>/working/.f && mkdir /working/OS && echo 'OS' > /working/OS/.theme

description:
1. Obtain a recursive listing of all entries under /working and save the full paths to a file named "found_paths.txt".
2. From "found_paths.txt", select entries whose final path component is "workspace", verify each selected entry is a regular file, and record all verified regular-file paths into "candidates.txt".
3. Determine whether "candidates.txt" contains any entries and write a short summary (including the count and the list of verified paths) to "summary.txt" to prepare for the final presence check.

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).

create.init: rm -rf /working; mkdir /working && echo 123>/working/.tmp && echo 123>/working/.tm12p && echo 123>/working/.f && mkdir /working/OS && echo 'OS' > /working/OS/.theme && mkdir /working/OS/workspace

description:
1. Create a folder named "temp_workspace" and obtain a complete recursive inventory of /working, saving it as "temp_workspace/listing.txt".  
2. From "temp_workspace/listing.txt", extract and verify entries that are regular files with the basename "workspace", and record their absolute paths to "temp_workspace/matches.txt".  
3. Consolidate "temp_workspace/matches.txt" into a short report "temp_workspace/decision_prep.txt" listing the number of matches and their full paths, and mark that report as ready for the final presence check.

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).

create.init: rm -rf /working; mkdir /working && echo 123>/working/.tmp && echo 123>/working/.tm12p && echo 123>/working/.f && mkdir /working/OS && echo 'OS' > /working/OS/.theme && touch /working/OS/workspace

description:
1. Recursively enumerate all regular files under /working and save their full paths to a file named "file_list.txt" for later checks.  
2. From "file_list.txt", select entries whose basename is exactly "workspace", confirm each selected entry is a regular file (not a directory or other special file), and write confirmed matching paths to "matches.txt" while also creating "match_flag.txt" containing "1" if any matches were found or "0" if none.  
3. Based on "match_flag.txt", prepare a single-line summary file named "final_check.txt" containing "present" if a match exists or "absent" if not, ensuring this summary is ready for the final decision step.

If a regular file named "workspace" exists in /working (recursively)? If so, output "yes", otherwise output "no" (with out quotes).
